about: Cards the deck census's band draw (tools/cubelab/deckcensus.ts, `decks --band`) never deals into a deck, because Forge's AI cannot finish their games inside the atlas's branch budget: an ENGINE limitation, measured, not a design judgement. A card goes here only with a measured stall (branches timed out inside one engine step with the card on the board) or a measured fork crash (D492: every branch dying at its GameCopier fork with the card's effect on the board), and, when the crash is a mechanic's own code path, every pool card with that mechanic, each naming the measurement it rides on. Read by the band census draw alone; never by `decks --cube`, the cube lab's drafts, the evolve loop or the board.

Scute Swarm.why: copies itself on every land drop, so boards reach 50-127 tokens and Forge's AI attack/block prediction iterates them for 1,000-1,300 s inside one event-free engine step that the branch deadline (D467) cannot see; 134 of spine s04's 135 timed-out branches had it on the battlefield (124 with 40+ copies), 14 unit kills, 0 on the other three spines

Chain of Smog.why: 'target player discards two cards; that player may copy this spell and choose a new target for the copy': with Forge's AI in both seats each copies it back at the other without end, so the engine runs 82,000-599,000 events (median 272,000) inside one step until the branch deadline (D467/D484) fires; 494 of spine s06's 2,925 branch games timed out (486 inside one step, 4 at a confirm or target callback, 4 with no error text), every one with it on the stack at the last state of a seat's log (492 in seat 0's, the other 2 in seat 1's), against a 1.3 s mean (0.85 s median) for the spine's other branches; 0 timeouts in the night's five other spines; the step ran past the runner's 10,800 s cap and failed the job

Emeritus of Abundance.why: Prepare (AlternateMode:Prepare): when the creature enters prepared, Forge makes a command-zone effect holding a copy of its prepared spell in exile with the static 'MayPlay$ True | MayPlayPlayer$ EffectSourceController' (AlterAttributeEffect, 'Prepared'); in a game copy -- the atlas's fork, GameCopier.makeCopy -> checkStateEffects -> StaticAbilityContinuous.applyContinuousAbility -- the copier sets an effect's source only for battlefield cards, so the copied command-zone effect has none, EffectSourceController resolves to no player, the defined-players list is empty and 2.0.14's line 900 indexes it unguarded (IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 0 out of bounds for length 0), so every branch from then on dies at its fork: J176 s03 (legacy, spine seed 2129), the opponent's Emeritus of Abundance entered at turn 7 and 1,200 of 1,300 branch games errored, every branch of every decision from turn 10 on (d2-d5, 300 of 300 each), 0 turns played; d0 and d1, before it entered, were clean; the spine ended in 71 s with no labels

Ob Nixilis, the Adversary.why: Casualty X with 'NonLegendary$ True | SetLoyalty$': when the AI pays the casualty the copy resolves as a nonlegendary TOKEN planeswalker that still carries the Casualty keyword, and the atlas's fork cannot copy it: GameCopier.createCardCopy re-makes every token as new TokenInfo(token).makeOneToken(owner, id) and copies the copiable characteristics (the loyalty among them) only after that returns; makeOneToken builds a Planeswalker with baseLoyalty still '' and adds the token's keywords one by one, the first addIntrinsicKeyword refreshes the view's ability text, which asks CardState.getReplacementEffects for the planeswalker's loyalty replacement, built from 'etbCounter:LOYALTY:' + baseLoyalty = 'etbCounter:LOYALTY:', which String.split(':') makes two parts, and CardFactoryUtil.makeEtbCounter line 550 reads part [2] (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 2 out of bounds for length 2) -- so every branch dies at its fork while the copy lives: J176 s07 (legacy, spine seed 2133), the opponent's Ob Nixilis cast with casualty at turn 7 made token copy id 97 ('Planeswalker - Nixilis', keywords [CASUALTY], loyalty 3), and 2,280 of 7,025 branch games errored, every branch of every decision while the token was on the battlefield (d3-d6, turns 8 and 10, 12 options, 190 of 190 each, random 1,800 and forge 480, 0 turns played); d2 (turn 6) before it and d7-d20 after it left (turn 10) were clean; reproduced on the pinned jar by a token copy made with 'CopyPermanent | NonLegendary$ True | SetLoyalty$ 3' (D494)
